text:
alice_acme: Hey team — we pushed to prod this morning and since ~09:12 UTC our app is getting much shorter, often incorrect answers for knowledge-base queries. Example attached from a paying customer — previously the model returned a 3-paragraph, cited answer; now it's one sentence and wrong. Escalating, please. :frowning:

emma: Thanks for flagging, really sorry about that. Can you paste one concrete prompt + response pair (both expected and actual) and an example request_id if you have one? Also which model/route you’re hitting?

alice_acme: Prompt: "What are the supported data retention options for Redwood Dedicated?"
Expected: multi-paragraph answer listing retention, export, audit options + links to console docs
Actual: "You can keep data as long as you like." (no links, wrong on default retention)
Request header snippet we log: `x-redwood-request-id: rwd-req-20260315-9b7e`
Route: `redwood.v1.generate` model pinned to `open-draft-v2` (we saw the route ID in our logs)

emma: Got it. I can see an alert from our quality monitors coinciding with your timestamp — eval-suite closed-book F1 dropped 0.74 -> 0.51 around 09:10 UTC for the `open-draft-v2` rollout. Adding @rajan and @sasha to investigate.

rajan: Thanks @emma. We ran a small spec/draft sampling rollout this morning (09:00 UTC) to enable the new speculative decoding path for `open-draft-v2` at 30% canary. The rollout config was:```json
{"model":"open-draft-v2","speculative_decoding":true,"sampler":"draft-sampler-v3","canary_pct":30}
```
I suspect the speculative path is being applied to external customers incorrectly — the sampler balances early draft proposals with greedy finalization and we may be failing to re-rank properly leading to premature stops/hallucinations.

sasha: I’m seeing many requests with `speculative_decoding=true` flag in our runtime logs post-09:00. Example trace (sanitized):
```
trace_id: trace-33fa
model=open-draft-v2
sampler=draft-sampler-v3
speculative_decoding=1
finalization_step=early_stop_token
cpu_time_ms=12
net_tokens=8
```
Where finalization_step shows many requests choosing an `early_stop_token` path. That aligns with the short answers.

emma: Can we reproduce with a curl snippet so customer can confirm? If so we should provide them a temporary workaround and roll back the canary.

rajan: Repro steps: run the same generate call but force the sampler flag. Example request:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"open-draft-v2",
    "input":"What are the supported data retention options for Redwood Dedicated?",
    "parameters":{
      "temperature":0.2,
      "speculative_decoding":true,
      "sampler":"draft-sampler-v3"
    }
  }'
```
If you compare this with `speculative_decoding:false` you'll see the difference.

alice_acme: Confirmed — when we set `speculative_decoding:false` locally the answer matches previous behavior. We can use that as a workaround but we don't control the global rollout so customers still hit the canary.

jordan: From product side, we need to treat this as a P0 regression. Customers are seeing semantic correctness drops. Notify accounts and offer rollback. @ops-oncall can you start rollback to 0% for `draft-sampler-v3`?

ops-oncall: On it. Will do an immediate canary rollback and notify infra. Command I’ll run:```bash
redwoodctl rollout set open-draft-v2 --feature speculative_decoding --canary 0
```
Expecting propagation ~5-8 minutes. Will post when done.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: rollout-update open-draft-v2 speculative_decoding canary 30->0 by ops-oncall at 2026-03-15T09:27:12Z :white_check_mark:

sasha: After rollback metrics are already improving on staging mirrors. We should still collect a set of failing examples and request traces to root cause re-ranking issue. @rajan can you prioritize a revert of the sampler logic or ensure final re-ranking uses scoring aligned with our eval metric?

rajan: Yup — I’ll open an internal PR to revert the sampler code path and add extra unit/eval tests. Early hypothesis: draft-sampler-v3 used an approximate scoring function to save tokens which biased towards short sequences under certain prompt-length distributions. Fix plan: restore exact scoring for final candidates + add a gating config to disable speculative decoding for K/high-trust customers.

emma: Action items
- Emma: collect 20 representative customer examples (alice_acme will share a pack) and attach request_ids and timestamps. (in progress)
- Rajan: PR to revert sampler changes + extra tests, target hotfix in next 24h.
- Sasha: add production trace retention for impacted timeslice and create an eval slice comparing `spec_decoding:true` vs false.
- Ops-oncall: completed rollback and notify customers.

alice_acme: Thanks — pls cc our AM when you have the rollback confirmation. We'll patch our app to force `speculative_decoding:false` for now while you fix.

jordan: We'll draft a customer-facing note and coordinate with growth/AMs. Postmortem assigned to the runtime team; timeline expected within 72h.

sasha: Quick note for debugging, if you need to find traces filter logs: `model=open-draft-v2 AND speculative_decoding=1 AND timestamp:[2026-03-15T09:00 TO 2026-03-15T09:30]`. Also sample query to extract request ids:```sql
SELECT request_id, final_token_count, chosen_candidate_score FROM runtime_traces
WHERE model='open-draft-v2' AND speculative_decoding=1
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
```

rajan: I'll include a regression test in CI that runs the closed-book suite with spec_decoding toggled and fails the build if delta > 0.05 F1.

emma: Thanks everyone. Alice — can you DM me the example pack + request ids? We’ll keep you updated and post the internal incident channel once we have the postmortem. :pray:

alice_acme: DM sent with 22 examples and the sample request id mentioned above. Appreciate the fast response.

(END THREAD)
